content.comment_body: This is a continuation from a previous thread discussing implementation of an analog demultiplexer.
Hello [user_name], Do you have a specific question or issue you'd like to discuss?

I'm aiming to set up an analog demultiplexer that stores daily count values into an analog flag, depending on the day of the week. While I've managed to handle the day-of-week logic, mapping these values into the analog flag using Demux 1:7 is proving tricky.
That sounds challenging. Since the forward/backward counter uses a DWord format (4 bytes), it can only be held in integer blocks (2 bytes) up to 32767, which causes issues for larger values.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are focused on developing an analog demultiplexer function that can store daily count values in analog flags, varying by day of the week. The main difficulty is understanding how to manage analog flags and properly store DWord counter data when faced with analog flag data type and size restrictions. Users are experiencing confusion due to limitations and lack of clarity in handling large data types within the expected product features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope the product will offer straightforward and adaptable means to store daily counter values in analog flags, regardless of data type size, utilizing demultiplexing logic.
